description:
The titanium Rolly Polly was an experimental project with Anaheim Electronics and Kyoot Industries. With Anaheim fully occupied by the mobile project, Kyoot subcontracted ORA Engineering in Taiwan to produce the Lunar Titanium Rolly Polly.
Military grade 3Al 2.5V titanium tubes were custom drawn to spec, creating an ultra light alloy not used in any mini bike to date. The project required three months of lab testing. ZERO compromises were made, resulting in a sub six pound frame and fork.
The titanium Rolly Polly is available in a single size, sharing the same geometry as the 4130 chromoly version. Previously, only New Types, the most elite pilots, were able to operate machines of this level. With our S.W.A.G. Small Wheel Adjusted Geometry interface, everyday riders can now experience the control and responsiveness of this new type of bicycle. The design is simple, easy to ride, and easy to maintain. Anyone can own a titanium Rolly Polly and keep it running for years with little to no maintenance in the field.
Lunar titanium is known for its ultra durable finish, resisting Minovsky Particles and the common corrosion found on Earth. It delivers a uniquely springy ride quality for riders seeking the ideal balance of weight and strength.
These frames are extremely difficult to manufacture, which limits production to small batches. Due to the labor, specialized tooling, and unique manufacturing techniques available only at ORA Engineering, large scale production simply is not possible. We would like to thank Jim and his team in Taiwan for making this project a reality. The result is the highest quality mini bike known to the universe, and we are proud to finally share it with the world.
One size fits most (5’2” to 6’3”). Our frame geometry grows as you raise your seat height. This allows for a full range of rider sizes just by adjusting saddle height. Standover height is 698mm or 27.5” from the ground.

Frame & Fork

100% heat treated muilt butted-3Al 2.5V Lunar titanium

BMX integrated headtube IS42/IS42 - Campy 45/45deg. size bearings

Water bottle mounts, rack mounts, fender mounts

Standard 68mm threaded bottom bracket

34.9 seat clamp diameter, 31.6 size seatpost and dropper post ready cable routing.

Fork Steer tube is 420mm uncut.

Raw Stardust finish. Electromagnetic gradient fade logo.

Proudly manufactured in Taiwan designed in Austin, TX
